title: Non-anchor position period prediction lane
rationale: This lane is a pre-registered structural position test, not another public-anchor mining pass. It excludes candidate words, key-material offsets, routed public additive fragments, and public known-plaintext anchor fragments from discovery and primary evidence. Any future score must come from independently documented non-anchor observations selected before evaluation.
prediction_target: Future independently documented non-anchor K4 position observations should concentrate in predeclared one-based absolute-position residue classes for the registered period family more than expected under seeded best-of-period null controls.
discovery_inputs: Predeclared period-family structural rule over one-based K4 absolute positions
K4 ciphertext length and the predeclared non-anchor position universe
No candidate key material, no public additive-fragment scores, no route tuning, and no source observation positions
evaluation_inputs: Future source-documented non-anchor K4 position observations selected after source review and before scoring
Observation files with per-position source notes and validation against the registered non-anchor universe
Independent target positions that are not public known-plaintext anchor fragments and are not derived from anchor additive-key values
controls: seeded same-size non-anchor position shuffle baseline
best-of-period null control across the registered period family
multiple-comparison correction across evaluated residue classes and sibling lanes
promotion blocked unless future independent observations beat null controls without post-hoc retuning
